proposal_scope: Common design proposal v4. No source selection, bank generation, fitting, truth opening, or scientific freeze has occurred. v4 fixes tail directions, deterministic update/grid rules, verified geometry, panel roles, memory/cost semantics, count receipts, and rare-stratum missingness.

starting_resource.selection_rule: Use this published selected state; do not choose initialization from fresh answers or TRR-0010 evaluation truth.

ownership_and_boundaries.agent_one: Directional readout implementation and fits; owns this common-contract proposal.
ownership_and_boundaries.agent_two: Nested public fitting-bank preparation and fixed-readout data-scaling controls.
ownership_and_boundaries.shared_artifacts: Public preparation artifacts are read-only across worktrees and bound by exact path, size, and SHA-256.
ownership_and_boundaries.forbidden: No P03 holdout, private study workspace/results, active-registry edits, paid compute, or truth-driven selection.
ownership_and_boundaries.truth_boundary: Freeze source identities, fit/validation roles, model outputs, thresholds, and the final panel before one common natural-evaluation truth opening.

arms.role: continued-training control for current coverage (second required control; no pre-data strength ranking)
data-scaling control with equal optimizer opportunities

crossed_design.a1_a2_comparators: A1+A2 is one historical comparator with one bound method/state identity; bind it before final evaluation. It is not a new A1-only or A2-only arm, and A2 is never deployed.

current.source: The exact published 1,200-record TRR-0009 improved public fitting bank is reused unchanged as B0; it is not an unspecified nested subset.
current.controlled_draw_accounting: If replacement sampling is used, report the exact controlled-draw count and draw semantics; this proposal imposes no minimum controlled-record or controlled-draw floor.
current.reuse_rule: Known old fitting, validation, or opened-evaluation identities are excluded from NEW B1 additions and from the final natural evaluation panel. That exclusion does not retroactively filter the intentionally reused published B0.

expanded.construction_and_accounting_note: A2 must bind whether the expanded bank preserves the current mixture or appends natural rows; any mixture change is a data-factor deviation, not silently called pure coverage.

a2_strata_proposal_pending_manifest.mixture_warning: A2 rejects an all-natural append as a mixture confound: the current 10% controlled share would fall to approximately 1%; unique new-parent availability and public-cache capacity remain to be verified.
a2_strata_proposal_pending_manifest.interface_note: A2 accepts score rows with normalized query/scale inputs and optional base-logit E inputs; capacity must freeze the executable interface before fit.
a2_strata_proposal_pending_manifest.controlled_draw_accounting: The B0 proposal contains 120 controlled records (60 Pile and 60 Finance); exact replacement-draw semantics remain an A2 artifact field, with no invented minimum.

feasibility_pending_artifact.interpretation: The required new-parent counts are 3,240 Pile and 2,160 Finance; they are not an availability claim. Exact candidate/exclusion receipts remain pending.

expanded.coverage_note: At the recommended 12,000 updates, 6,144,000 position draws over the estimated 1.24M expanded valid positions give approximately 4.94 exposures; use the explicit five-exposure gate in training_geometry_and_schedule.

construction_and_accounting.natural_only_append_warning: If expanded preparation can only append natural rows on top of the current bank, report the data factor as coverage-plus-mixture rather than pure coverage.

sampling_requirements: Expanded rows must be new unique public examples with varied token identities and contexts, not repetitions or a replacement mixture of the same size.
Fit-bank rows are excluded from the final natural panel, public validation panel, and known train/validation/opened-evaluation ledgers permitted by the charter.
A2 reports distinct records, post-BOS positions, supported-token counts, frequency strata, repeated exposures, and exact sampler draws.
No fit-bank count or support set is chosen using final evaluation answers.
public_banks.coverage_note: At the 12,000-update lower bound, 6,144,000 position draws over the estimated 1.24M expanded valid positions give approximately 4.94 exposures; use the explicit five-exposure gate in training_geometry_and_schedule.

training_geometry_and_schedule.geometry_gate: Verified full width-192 fit geometry and separate width-128 natural-validation geometry; no crop substitution.
training_geometry_and_schedule.exact_update_count_freeze: Freeze the exact integer N from the deterministic formula before fitting; do not choose it from final outcomes.
training_geometry_and_schedule.schedule: Cosine decay, AdamW, base learning rate 2e-4, weight_decay=0, gradient_clip_norm=1.0, seed 4010; no staging schedule, teacher ranking, search, or A2 fallback.
training_geometry_and_schedule.expanded_bank_coverage_reason: Compute actual_B1_valid_positions from the bound expanded bank. The formula targets at least five valid-position exposures and rounds N upward in common 1,000-update increments.
training_geometry_and_schedule.validation_selection: Earliest maximum of a predeclared domain-balanced public token-accuracy score on the exact sorted-unique checkpoint grid [0, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 12000, N]; ties choose earliest.
training_geometry_and_schedule.source_interface: Fit rows and natural-validation clips use separately declared context widths; fitting uses verified all-valid geometry and final clips retain 127 post-BOS positions.

expanded_position_exposure_requirement.freeze_rule: Compute actual_B1_valid_positions from the bound expanded bank; if formula-derived N exceeds 20,000, stop for contract revision.

training_geometry_and_schedule.checkpoint_grid_rule: At execution replace symbolic N by its exact integer, sort and deduplicate the grid, and evaluate no other checkpoints.
training_geometry_and_schedule.recommended_schedule_receipt: A2 fixed-control review proposed 12,000 updates; v4 replaces that provisional count with the deterministic N formula.

exact_update_count_formula.cap_rule: If computed N exceeds 20,000, stop and request contract revision before any fit; never silently cap or reduce exposure.
exact_update_count_formula.common_arm_rule: Use the same exact integer N for all four arms.

verified_geometry.statement: The fit mask is full width-192 geometry; width-128 is only the natural-evaluation clip.

directional_readout.goal: Genuine token-specific scoring-vector direction freedom beyond gain/bias-only calibration and a global absorbable transform.
directional_readout.base_readout: Published FP32 public embedding/readout E remains the immutable anchor for all vocabulary rows.
directional_readout.parameterization: E_eff[v] = E[v] + Delta[v] for v in supported fitting rows S; E_eff[v] = E[v] outside S. Delta[S] is a full independent [|S|, 2048] FP32 row table.
directional_readout.initialization: Delta[S] is zero-initialized; the public E rows and logits/argmax must be bit-equivalent at step zero.
directional_readout.optimizer: Decoder base learning rate remains 2e-4 in the common schedule; directional Delta learning rate is proposed as 1e-4. All four arms receive the same declared optimizer opportunity, with no hidden directional-only schedule; exact optimizer implementation remains capacity-owned.
directional_readout.regularization: lambda * mean_v[(1 + 4/sqrt(count_v)) * ||Delta[v]||_2^2 / (H * rms(E[v])^2 + eps)] with lambda=1e-4; frequency-weighted relative L2 to E.
directional_readout.safety_bound: CAPACITY_PROPOSAL_REQUIRED; structural checks must still show unsupported rows unchanged and no global transform.
directional_readout.support_definition: S is every vocabulary row with positive fitting-bank count; absent rows have no adapter parameters and remain the base readout.
directional_readout.deployment: Merged full readout W is the required training-qualification and inference path; no special validation hook is assumed. Any sparse supported-column implementation is diagnostic-only for output-equivalence checks and cannot be used as a fit, validation, or deployment fallback. W replaces E in deployed storage.
structural_checks: Unsupported rows are tensor-equivalent to the public anchor.
Updates are not constrained to scalar gain/bias or one global transform; non-collinear token-row updates are checked on public/synthetic diagnostics.
Support IDs, counts, adapter tensors, optimizer state, and serialized artifact sizes are recorded separately.
Any sparse score implementation is diagnostic-only and must match merged-W outputs before it is retained as an audit artifact.
directional_readout.capacity_preference: Use full independent supported rows and merged-W training/inference after qualification with a measured safety margin below the approximately 12.2 GiB live-free-memory snapshot; no sparse fallback is permitted.

row_support.expanded_support_bound: |S| <= 128256; bind actual expanded support before fit.

directional_readout.row_constraints: No hard gain/bias bound and no row renormalization. Unsupported rows have no adapter parameter and remain E exactly.
directional_readout.qualification_memory: Capacity handoff estimates merged-primary memory at 6.389 GiB for current support and 11.477 GiB for full-vocabulary support. These are not GPU qualification results. The 12.2 GiB value is a live-free-memory snapshot, not reserved capacity; qualify actual B1 support with a measured margin and fail closed.

capacity_final_handoff.primary_score_path: merged materialized effective E for score_rows, forward, training, validation, inference
capacity_final_handoff.serialization_assertion: PASS: nonzero-Delta serialized W reload preserves full logits and argmax IDs against the merged primary path; sparse path remains diagnostic-only.

validation.panel: Opened TRR-0009 matched public natural panel, proposed as TRR-0010 public development only.
validation.metric: Equal-domain-weighted natural token accuracy: mean(Finance token accuracy, Pile token accuracy); target conditions remain paired within source.
validation.checkpoint_rule: Earliest maximum at the declared checkpoint interval; no final truth is opened for this selection.
validation.bank_exclusion: Validation records and derived rows are excluded from both fitting banks and the final natural panel.
validation.fit_vs_validation_geometry: Fit context width 192; natural validation clip width 128 with 127 scored post-BOS positions.
validation.selection_scope: Selection validation is exactly the 384 matched-public observations: 256 Finance + 128 Pile, public_base only. The LoRA target is not used for checkpoint selection.
validation.secondary: The inherited 48-record style-balanced panel is secondary diagnostic context only, not checkpoint-selection evidence.

a1_a2_common_subset.role: single historical A1_plus_A2 comparator on the same proposed final panel
a1_a2_common_subset.denominator_statement: When the corrected intersection is complete, the historical A1+A2 comparator and all four TRR-0010 arms use the same 128 Finance + 128 Pile source records and two paired target conditions; source records, not target observations, are the bootstrap unit.
a1_a2_common_subset.availability_note: Root-reviewed native A1+A2 metadata indicates 128/domain common-panel feasibility and per-cell warm timing of approximately 262–267 seconds; this is planning metadata, not a TRR-0010 fit or quality result.

final_evaluation.roles: The 128 Finance + 128 Pile final panel is also the common A1+A2 comparison panel. Select it once after methods and exclusion ledgers are frozen; do not create a smaller nested confirmation panel or expand after outcomes.
metrics: exact recovery of all 127 post-BOS positions per clip
final_evaluation.exclusions: All known fitting, validation, opened-evaluation, TRR-0009, and approved other-study ledgers; no P03 holdout or private workspace access.
final_evaluation.panel_size_rationale: Proposed 128 records per domain because root-reviewed A1+A2 availability supports a common panel of that size within existing public ranges; exact-gain precision is limited, and corrected zero-overlap scanning must confirm the panel before selection. Do not use the prior pre-TRR-0009-exclusion Pile cardinality or any larger Pile-panel availability notion.
final_evaluation.corrected_exclusion_note: The final intersection must apply the union of the approved P08 r1/r2 and TRR-0009 exclusions. A prior Pile count predating TRR-0009 exclusions is not an eligible final-panel count.

extension_attempt.reason: Published partition guard rejected Pile row 6022 below the declared holdout start; no fit-row bypass or extension was attempted.

useful_outcome_proposal.fixed_control_selection: Directional route compares expanded_directional with both expanded_fixed (matched data) and current_fixed (second required current-coverage control); no posthoc fixed-arm winner or pre-data strength ranking.

token.ceiling_policy: If the relevant fixed accuracy leaves less than 0.5 percentage points of attainable headroom, report the absolute floor as ceiling-limited rather than as a failure; require the relative-error reduction, positive paired lower bound, and the predeclared A1+A2 anchor gap-closure evidence for a useful claim.

gap_closure.formula: closure_m = (M_candidate - M_unchanged_shared_start) / (M_A1_plus_A2 - M_unchanged_shared_start), computed on the common final panel per source-record bootstrap draw when the denominator is positive.
gap_closure.lower_bound_requirement: >= 0.25 on the same declared metric and anchor subset
gap_closure.unknown_rule: If any bootstrap denominator is nonpositive or the visibility floor is not met, mark the whole ratio route UNKNOWN; never discard nonpositive denominators opportunistically.
gap_closure.scope: Data and directional routes each report common-panel closure separately; no A1-only/A2-only decomposition.

useful_outcome_proposal.family_rule: Exact and token routes are separate predeclared routes, each route alpha 0.025; data and directional factor decisions are separate scientific questions with no pooled domains, target conditions, or metric families.
useful_outcome_proposal.interpretation: Useful result is mechanism evidence for this crossed study only. It does not automatically replace the reference, retrain, or expand the panel.
useful_outcome_proposal.control_requirement: Directional usefulness is reported separately from the data-scaling route. A flat directional contrast does not fail the study if expanded_fixed clears the predeclared data route.
useful_outcome_proposal.baseline: unchanged_shared_start (the shared TRR-0009 continued-fixed selected state)

directional_useful.contrast: expanded_directional versus expanded_fixed, with expanded_directional versus current_fixed as the required robustness comparison
directional_useful.success: Material absolute readout-direction route in both domains with all main-cell safeguards/cost gates; rare/absent strata are reported diagnostically.

data_useful.success: Material expanded-coverage route in both domains with baseline-to-A1+A2 anchor closure and all main-cell safeguards/cost gates; rare/absent strata are reported diagnostically; this route can succeed when directional interaction is flat.

combined_candidate.success: Report total improvement and interaction; do not replace the separate directional/data decisions.

useful_outcome_proposal.domain_rule: A route is study-useful only when its declared material absolute criterion and positive paired lower bound hold separately in both Finance and Pile. A one-domain result is reported as domain-specific evidence, not a global promotion.

harm_safeguards.confidence: One-sided lower q_0.05 bound for candidate-minus-control delta; require LCB >= the declared negative margin.

rare_absent.underpowered: UNKNOWN when fewer than 32 exposed source records; zero exposed sources are NO_EXPOSURE/UNKNOWN, never automatic PASS or zero-harm evidence.
rare_absent.route_role: Diagnostic-only. UNKNOWN rare/absent bins do not automatically veto a main useful route; if support reaches 32 sources, report the lower harm bound separately.

safeguards_and_cost.qualification: Qualify the largest expanded-directional cell and merged serialized adapter before the full matrix with fail-closed wall, disk, host-RSS, isolated-GPU-memory, and output-equivalence guards plus a measured free-memory margin; stop on allocator, driver, or output-equivalence anomalies. The current proposal is not execution-ready until the caps are jointly agreed.
safeguards_and_cost.streaming: Public activation generation and expanded-bank preparation are chunked; no unbounded resident corpus or artifact expansion.
safeguards_and_cost.deployed_artifact_accounting: An exported full readout W replaces the shared E file in deployed inference; do not charge E + W. Report the full training checkpoint, optimizer state, and preparation artifacts separately because they can be much larger.
safeguards_and_cost.memory_gate_unit: Gate memory using each method's isolated peak; pooled four-arm harness peaks are reported separately and are not deployment-memory gates.
safeguards_and_cost.candidate_to_a1_a2_cost_gate: Measure candidate_warmed_runtime / A1+A2_warmed_runtime on the common panel; PASS requires <=0.25 when the comparator is bound, otherwise UNKNOWN.

resource_caps.hard_guard: No unbounded run; stop before full matrix unless all four caps and fail-closed guards are jointly agreed from a representative largest-cell receipt.

resource_estimate_from_published_trr0009.interpretation: Published peaks are qualification references, not guarantees. Expanded activations and directional state require a fresh preflight and representative qualification before a full run.
resource_estimate_from_published_trr0009.directional_adapter_capacity_note: Capacity binds full supported-row parameter count, optimizer state, merged-readout workspace, and qualification memory before fit.
resource_estimate_from_published_trr0009.memory_note: The 12.2 GiB value is a live free-memory snapshot, not reserved GPU capacity; qualification must retain a measured safety margin.
resource_estimate_from_published_trr0009.capacity_final_handoff_status: Implementation/tests reviewed; merged-W serialization smoke PASS; memory estimates are not GPU qualification.

coordination_status.agent_two: A2 feasibility is recorded as required parent counts, not availability; exact recipe hashes, exclusion receipts, and final source/validation bindings remain pending.
coordination_status.capacity: Root reviewed full supported rows, directional learning rate 1e-4, merged-W training/inference, and the v2 serialized-W reload smoke; precise free-memory margin and largest-cell GPU qualifier remain pending.
coordination_status.resource_caps: Wall, disk, host-RSS, and isolated-GPU caps remain deferred to measured largest-cell qualification; no unbounded run and no execution-ready claim.
coordination_status.destination_approval_scope: Destination/public contract-sharing approval does not substitute for A2 contract agreement or resource qualification.

non_agreements_pending_review: Exact expanded-bank recipe hashes, parent/row exclusions, controlled-draw semantics, and source inventory from A2.
Exact common optimizer schedule and directional learning-rate implementation before fitting.
Capacity qualification of merged-W training/inference with a measured margin below the 12.2 GiB live-free-memory snapshot.
A1+A2 comparator identity/cost receipt; corrected count scan is 3,867 Finance and 236 Pile after the TRR9+P08 union.
Root agreement on the common 128/domain panel; no extension is planned from the excluded 6,000 Pile probe.

source_record_bootstrap.sampling: With replacement within each domain; all methods and declared target conditions for a source remain paired within each draw.
source_record_bootstrap.frequency_strata: Resample source records, then sum correct and exposed-token numerators/denominators within each draw; do not average per-record stratum accuracies.
source_record_bootstrap.pooling: Domains, target conditions, and metric families remain separate; no pooled pass is reported.

benefit_routes.bound: q_alpha of the paired source-record bootstrap delta

harm_safeguards.bound: q_alpha of candidate-minus-control delta; require the lower bound to be >= the declared negative harm margin

gap_closure.bound: q_alpha of the source-record bootstrap closure fraction when the visibility rule is met

confidence_tails.descriptive_points: Report point deltas and denominators even when a bound or route is UNKNOWN.

exact_binary.unit: paired source-record exact outcome (all 127 post-BOS positions in each 128-token clip)

checkpoint_selection.metric: Equal-domain-weighted token accuracy: mean(Finance token accuracy, Pile token accuracy).
checkpoint_selection.rule: At execution replace N by the exact formula-derived integer, sort and deduplicate [0, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 12000, N], choose the earliest checkpoint attaining the maximum metric, and break exact ties by earliest step. Do not use final-panel outcomes, LoRA validation, or posthoc grid changes.

contrast_rules.benefit_delta: candidate minus the named fixed comparator, paired per source record; report the percentile lower bound under the route alpha.
contrast_rules.harm_delta: candidate minus the named fixed comparator, paired per source record; report the one-sided lower q_0.05 bound and compare it with the negative harm margin.
contrast_rules.rare_missingness: Fewer than 32 exposed source records is UNKNOWN; zero exposed sources are NO_EXPOSURE/UNKNOWN and never a zero-harm result.
contrast_rules.ratio_denominator: For each remaining-error or gap-closure ratio route, if ANY bootstrap denominator is nonpositive, mark the WHOLE ratio interval UNKNOWN; never discard such draws opportunistically or treat them as zero.

exact_binary_bounds.unit: paired source-record exact outcome (all 127 post-BOS positions in each 128-token clip)

token_zero_variance.condition: The source-record bootstrap token delta has zero observed-difference variance.
token_zero_variance.decision: UNKNOWN for the route or safeguard under review.
token_zero_variance.interpretation: Do not treat a degenerate bootstrap interval as proof of no harm or adequate uncertainty.

statistical_procedure.route_separation: Token versus exact and directional versus data routes are separate predeclared questions. Each useful route uses alpha=0.025; no pooled family claim or post-score threshold substitution is allowed.

deployment: Merged full readout W is the required training-qualification and inference path; no special validation hook is assumed. Any sparse supported-column implementation is diagnostic-only for output-equivalence checks and cannot be used as a fit, validation, or deployment fallback. W replaces E in deployed storage.
